evals.name: actuarial-client-readout
evals.prompt: I have a quarterly reserve review for a health plan client tomorrow. Build me a 6-slide PowerPoint deck: (1) title slide, (2) executive summary, (3) reserve adequacy trend using these figures: Q1 IBNR $42.1M booked vs $40.8M indicated, Q2 $44.5M vs $43.9M, Q3 $47.2M vs $48.1M, Q4 $49.8M vs $51.5M, (4) key drivers: specialty drug spend +18% YoY, ER utilization back to baseline, two large stop-loss claims, (5) recommendation: strengthen reserves by $1.7M, (6) next steps. Use my actuarial-signal palette. Save it as reserve-review.pptx.
evals.expected_output: Valid 6-slide .pptx using actuarial-signal token values throughout, JetBrainsMono Nerd Font, light title background, rendered QA images, no Anthropic stock palette colors.

evals.name: healthcare-theme-selection
evals.prompt: Make me a short deck (5 slides) summarizing our patient-experience pilot for the hospital steering committee: pilot ran 90 days in 3 clinics, NPS up from 31 to 52, average check-in time down from 9.5 minutes to 4 minutes, staff adoption 78%, two clinics already asking to expand. End with the ask: approve rollout to all 12 clinics. Save it as patient-experience-pilot.pptx, and write a short NOTES.md saying what design choices you made.
evals.expected_output: Valid 5-slide .pptx using one of the four approved palettes chosen by subject matter (human-outcomes is the natural fit), stated explicitly in NOTES.md; JetBrainsMono Nerd Font; light title background.
